title: SWF: ActionNextFrame/PrevFrame/GotoFrame in timeline
description: Verify that gotoAndPlay(frame), gotoAndStop(frame) compile to the correct AVM1 opcodes. ActionGotoFrame (0x81) takes a uint16 literal frame number. ActionGotoAndPlay/GotoAndStop are 0x05 and 0x07 alternatives. But gotoAndPlay(expr) where expr is not a literal should use ActionCallFrame or ActionGotoFrame2 (0x9F). Check packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts for gotoAndPlay/gotoAndStop handling. Fix if using wrong opcodes. Add tests.
